_comment: Single source of truth for all role model chains. IDs re-verified against `opencode models` (2026-11-04, OpenCode 2.2.5): every entry present and active. OpenCode Go ($X/5h quota pools) is the primary lane; free NIM/Groq/opencode-free rungs are the overflow. Ordering is per-role as specified by the user. chains -> generated agents/* via scripts/gen-fallbacks.py. Do not edit generated files by hand.
_last_resort_comment: Global floor, tried IN ORDER after a role's own rungs are exhausted and before the mastermind takes over. 2026-11-04: nvidia_secondary and opencode/free Nemotron routes are NOT used (user rule) - the NIM lane is nvidia/. Primary is free; codestral and gemini-2.5-flash are the paid safety nets.

families._comment: Critic and code-reviewer must differ BY FAMILY from EVERY model in author_models (coder, debugger, takeovers). Scope is critic + code-reviewer only (AGENTS.md names the critic; security-reviewer and final-verifier intentionally reuse author families because they verify mechanically - commands, tests, secret scans - rather than judging code the authors wrote). Only the Nemotron group is merged (explicit user rule: Nemotron NIM and Nemotron Zen are one family); every other model is its own family. Both provider spellings are listed so family() resolves nvidia and nvidia_secondary routes to the same family.

mastermind.label: Mastermind
mastermind._flag: 2026-11-04: Go plan. deepseek first (tool-call loop), glm + mimo spread the other quota pools, NIM deepseek as free overflow.

planner.label: Analyst/Planner
planner._flag: 2026-11-04: rung 3 was GLM-5.3; replaced with mimo-v2.6-pro so the ladder has three distinct families (glm, deepseek, mimo). NIM has no plain glm-5.3 - overflow uses glm-5.3-flash.

coder.label: Coder
coder._flag: 2026-11-04: deepseek -> glm -> mimo -> opencode free deepseek. Groq qwen was tried first and REJECTED with a live 400: the free tier caps input at 7000 ITPM while this system prompt is ~13.2K tokens, so every Groq request fails before the model sees it.

tester.label: Tester
tester._flag: 2026-11-04: mimo first (terminal output parsing), qwen third, opencode free mimo as overflow.

debugger.label: Debugger
debugger._flag: 2026-11-04: rung 3 was GLM-5.3 (duplicate family of rung 2); replaced with longcat-2.0 - 1M context for large logs and tracebacks. Overflow GLM on NIM is glm-5.3-flash.

critic.label: Critic
critic._flag: 2026-11-04: rebuilt for the family rule. Author families are deepseek/glm/mimo/qwen (coder) and minimax/glm/longcat (debugger). Critic uses nemotron, google, claude, mistral - zero overlap. The user's original glm/deepseek/mimo-pro ladder shared every author family, so it could not satisfy the rule.

designer.label: Designer
designer._flag: 2026-11-04: deepseek-v4.1-flash is treated as vision-capable per the user; all rungs remain image-capable. Free overflow is the real opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free ID.

copywriter.label: Copywriter
copywriter._flag: 2026-11-04: glm -> haiku -> deepseek -> gemini. There is no free Gemini 3.8 variant in the registry; google/gemini-3.8-flash is the proven route (user approved).

explorer.label: Repository Explorer
explorer._flag: 2026-11-04: longcat-2.0 first for its 1M context (grep/scan heavy work). Overflow Nemotron is the nvidia/ route - no nvidia_secondary, no opencode free.

code-reviewer.label: Code Reviewer
code-reviewer._flag: 2026-11-04: rebuilt for the family rule (same constraint as critic, different order). Gemini first for fast diff review; nemotron for depth.

archiver.label: Archiver + GitHub
archiver._flag: 2026-11-04: 3-rung by design. No free/overflow rung on purpose: archiver handles commit and push state, so it stays on the paid Go lane (secrets never leave quota-protected providers).

security-reviewer.label: Security Reviewer
security-reviewer._flag: 2026-11-04: user-prescribed chain. Rung 3 was GLM-5.3 (banned); mimo-v2.6-pro is the user's first alternative. Rung 1 (most used) is a free independent family.

final-verifier.label: Final Verifier
final-verifier._flag: 2026-11-04: user-prescribed 3-rung chain. Mechanical verification (re-runs acceptance commands), so the critic family rule is deliberately not applied.

ui-reviewer.label: UI Reviewer
ui-reviewer._flag: 2026-11-04: all three image-capable. Rung 1 is the free vision model; rung 3 is minimax-m3 because opencode-go has no gemini-3.8-flash (registry check).

general.label: General Purpose
general._flag: 2026-11-04: free opencode mimo first, then Go deepseek/glm. 3-rung by design. Groq was tried and dropped: 7000 ITPM free-tier cap rejects this system prompt (13.2K tokens) with a live 400.
